name: Convert SOAP XML Object to JSON
description: Converts a SOAP XML Object received from Salesforce to JSON

configurable_props.name: infoBox
configurable_props.content:
This action is useful in conjunction with Salesforce Flow Builder, and is primarily used if Instant triggers are not working for your use case.
\
[See the documentation](https://pipedream.com/apps/salesforce-rest-api#troubleshooting) for more details.

configurable_props.name: xml
configurable_props.label: XML Soap Object
configurable_props.description: The object received from Salesforce that will be converted.

configurable_props.name: extractNotificationOnly
configurable_props.label: Extract Notifications Only
configurable_props.description: Whether to extract only the notification parts from the XML. Default: `true`.

configurable_props.name: failOnError
configurable_props.label: Fail on Error
configurable_props.description: Whether the action should fail if an error occurs when extracting notifications. Default: `false`.
